info.title: AMZ Automation Console CRM Read API
info.description: Independent read-only CRM integration for nine store-monitoring checks. Static contract of the current implementation; not a claim that this revision is deployed. HTTPS and exact configured Host are required for every listed route. No CORS is enabled. This is opaque bearer plus browser-bound ticket/session authentication, not OAuth. Success JSON envelopes and application/problem+json errors are distinct. Credentials in query keys containing token, ticket, password, secret or authorization are rejected. Unknown/repeated query parameters are rejected. No route starts sampling or writes Amazon/CRM business data. Structured output uses explicit allowlists with rule-based text redaction, not arbitrary-prose personal-data classification.

servers.description: CRM integration target. HTTPS and this configured canonical Host are required. Query /api/crm/v1 for the serving API capabilities; the checked-in contract alone does not establish which revision is deployed.

get.description: Reads only saved nine-check data. Does not start collection, contact Amazon, send CRM updates or include competitive intelligence. An Authorization header, if present at all, takes precedence over the CRM session cookie; invalid headers do not fall back to cookies. runId is required. All valid saved, allowlisted records are available by pagination, including all saved VOC child records; this does not assert complete Amazon collection. Fix snapshotId across pages to detect replacement. Conflicting same-ID files return 409 rather than selecting a copy. Inbox exposes result summaries only.

No existing credential is required. Creates a 120-second browser challenge and binding cookie, then redirects to a fixed configured CRM callback. The CRM must authenticate its subject and authorize the requested store before its backend issues a ticket. Never accept a caller-supplied callback URL.

303.description: Browser challenge created. Redirect to the configured CRM callback; no body. Separate HttpOnly browser binding lasts 120 seconds.

get.summary: Open a browser-bound monitor popup from the CRM SPA
get.description: Register the message listener before opening the popup synchronously from the CRM button; the bridge sends its challenge once. Creates a 120-second challenge and Secure HttpOnly binding cookie, then serves an HTML postMessage bridge to the one configured CRM origin. The configured CRM origin may use HTTP; the monitor remains HTTPS. Both windows check exact origin, window source, requestId and challengeId. The CRM backend independently authenticates its current user and store rights before signing. No CRM login token or monitor API token is sent through postMessage. Requires AMZGUARD_CRM_BRIDGE_ORIGIN; does not require the redirect callback. Shares the start rate limit with /crm/sso/start.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Fresh 32-byte base64url correlation value generated by the CRM page; not an identity or credential.

200.description: HTML popup bridge. Binding token is cookie-only; the page contains public challenge metadata. No opener or a mismatched opener cannot complete authorization.

post.description: CRM backend only. Bearer authentication is mandatory; a browser session cannot issue tickets. challengeId and all destination fields must match the browser challenge. One challenge permits one issued ticket. Ticket expires after at most 60 seconds and no later than its challenge. No caller-selected redirect is accepted.

requestBody.description: JSON object only; no unknown fields; maximum 8192 bytes. Content-Encoding must be absent or identity.

get.description: Loads HTML that reads the ticket from the URL fragment and POSTs JSON to /crm/sso/exchange. URL fragments are not HTTP query parameters. Every query parameter is rejected. No ticket or binding cookie is returned in HTML.

post.description: Requires the independent binding cookie created by sso/start, a valid single-use ticket in JSON, and exact same-origin headers. Consumes the ticket synchronously and creates a 30-minute CRM-only, single-store session. Clears the binding cookie. Tickets/sessions are in process memory; restart or CRM configuration change invalidates them.

CrmBearer.description: Configured opaque machine API token in Authorization: Bearer <token>, with exactly one space. Scheme matching is case-insensitive; the token must match exactly. Not JWT/OAuth. Cookies/query parameters cannot substitute for bearer on ticket issuance. On dual-auth API routes a present invalid Authorization header prevents cookie fallback.

CrmSession.name: __Host-amzguard_crm
CrmSession.description: Dedicated opaque browser session from ticket exchange; one store, read-only, 30 minutes, Secure/HttpOnly/Path=/SameSite=Lax. Independent of Dashboard authentication. Scope is revalidated on access.

CrmBrowserBinding.name: __Host-amzguard_crm_binding
CrmBrowserBinding.description: Separate 120-second HttpOnly/Secure browser-binding cookie from sso/start. A valid ticket alone cannot be exchanged without this cookie.

View.description: Initial navigation hint only; storeKey is the authorization scope. A session can read all nine checks for its one authorized store.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Null, where permitted, means the saved source did not have a valid timestamp.

StatusCode.description: Saved status normalized to this syntax; malformed or missing values become UNKNOWN. Future well-formed status codes are retained; clients must not treat an unfamiliar code as healthy.

RunId.description: Select an ID returned by runs. Safe saved IDs are retained; unsafe IDs become opaque:<64 lowercase hex>; absent IDs become stable legacy:<64 lowercase hex>. Derived IDs use SHA-256 of canonical JSON encoding. No synthetic combined-latest run is selectable.

SnapshotId.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the entire saved report, including other stores if present. Only the requested authorized store is projected. Bind subsequent data pages to this digest to detect replacement.

OpaqueCredential.description: Opaque random value; never log or put in a query string. This is not a JWT or OAuth credential.

BusinessValue.description: Saved allowlisted scalar or array of scalars, after text redaction. Nested objects are omitted. Historical field types are retained rather than coerced to a semantic type.

BusinessMetrics.description: Exact output allowlist for non-Inbox metrics. A missing field was absent or not an allowed scalar shape. No raw report metrics are returned.

InboxMetrics.description: Only typed counts, flags and calendar dates. No message/order identifiers, message rows, subjects or free text are projected.

BusinessItem.description: Exact saved business-item allowlist. Order identifiers may remain outside Inbox. Explicit buyer identity/contact and secret fields are excluded; known private values and recognized text patterns are redacted in permitted business strings. This rule-based filter does not identify every possible personal detail in arbitrary prose. Raw body/context, internal paths and screenshots are not public fields.

EvidencePart.description: available means a nonempty saved object without an error property. It is not proof of a successful live collection or complete pagination. Other fields are emitted only when present in the permitted saved shape.

Source.description: Per-result original run provenance. collectedAt uses the first valid time indicated by timeSource, with file mtime only as the last fallback; it is not always a confirmed sample time. Times more than five minutes in the future mark the result invalid and stale. Response generation does not initiate or refresh Amazon sampling.

ResultCommon.description: status and recordedSeverity/recordedOk retain saved values. The projection sets ERROR/ok=false for recognized uncertainty, evidence conflicts, invalid future timestamps, unrecognized normal-status claims or an OK claim lacking both available routes or having explicit route failure. Recorded performance events remain actionable as CRITICAL. Staleness yields COLLECTION action state without replacing the saved status. This conservative presentation does not repair upstream business-judgment defects or certify every apparent agreement.

CheckSummary.description: One entry for each of the nine checks. No saved result yields status [NEVER_RUN], severity null, resultCount 0 and results []. Different ASINs may retain different original runs.

Run.description: One immutable saved run. Date filters select matching results, but resultCount/savedRecordCount describe the entire authorized store fragment of that run. data returns that whole fragment, not just the date-filtered subset. Runs are ordered newest report clock first.

ReviewPage.description: Explicit saved review ID to page association only. No historical association is inferred. Empty reviewPages does not prove no screenshot existed; screenshot files/paths are never returned.

DataRecord.description: One stored result without business items, or one saved allowlisted item. VOC parent ASIN rows and all child records are expanded in saved order. Indices are zero-based within the selected store fragment. Invalid saved item shapes may project to an empty object or null; no item-count truncation is applied. Inbox always emits only its check-result row.

Pagination.description: total counts returned resource rows before page slicing, not Amazon-wide records. pages is ceil(total/pageSize); zero total has zero pages. A page beyond the end returns an empty data array.

completeness.const: All valid saved records allowed by the public-field policy; not a claim of complete Amazon collection.

MetadataCommon.description: Read-only saved-data scope and response time. ignoredReports counts skipped malformed, structurally invalid or future-dated report files in scanned check directories, not missing Amazon records. excluded names the projection policy, not a guarantee of recognizing arbitrary personal prose.

dateFilterMeaning.const: Per-result collection date in Asia/Shanghai; not review publication date.

paginationOrder.const: Saved result/item order; VOC ASIN followed by its saved records.

EnvelopeCommon.description: Successful JSON API responses only. generatedAt is response generation time, never a new Amazon sample. HTML, 303 redirects, the raw OpenAPI resource and problem responses do not use this envelope.

ssoAvailable.description: At least one SSO mode is configured on the monitor. This does not verify that the CRM integration is deployed.

checks.description: Current monitoring catalog; titles come from the server registry. No intelligence resources.

ssoModes.description: Configured modes in redirect, popup order. Older deployments may omit this additive field; do not assume popup support when it is absent.

subject.description: Stable CRM subject, without leading/trailing whitespace. The CRM backend must independently authorize this signed-in subject before requesting a ticket. Not returned by session endpoints.

loginUrl.description: Navigate the same browser used for sso/start to this URL. Ticket is in the fragment only; never copy it into a query. Treat the entire URL as a credential.

code.description: Known validation codes are listed in x-known-error-codes. Unexpected internal errors may retain a safe uppercase system code (for example ENOENT); clients must handle unknown codes. CRM_REQUEST_FAILED is the HTTP fallback if a read-layer failure lacks a code.

detail.description: Controlled validation text; all 500 responses use Internal server error.

instance.description: Request pathname only; query credentials are never reflected here.

OpenApiDocument.description: The raw OpenAPI document; not wrapped in the success envelope.

StoreKey.name: storeKey
StoreKey.description: Exact enabled store key available to the current CRM principal. Unknown or out-of-scope data resources return 404.

CheckId.name: checkId
CheckId.description: One of the nine monitoring checks; competitive intelligence is not included.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Decimal digits only, matching ^[1-9]\d*$. No leading zero, sign, exponent, whitespace or repeated parameter.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Decimal digits only, matching ^[1-9]\d*$. Values above 200 are rejected, not clamped.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive start of each result collection date in Asia/Shanghai. Must be a real calendar date; from must not exceed to. This does not filter review publication dates.

To.name: to
To.description: Inclusive end of each result collection date in Asia/Shanghai; must be a real calendar date.

RunId.name: runId
RunId.description: Use the exact runId from runs; it must resolve to a saved report. The request parser accepts non-control text, but no invented latest aggregate is available.

SnapshotId.name: snapshotId
SnapshotId.description: Recommended on every page after selection. Mismatch returns 409 SNAPSHOT_CHANGED; without it a replaced report can be read under the same runId. Conflicting simultaneous copies always fail with REPORT_CONFLICT, even with snapshotId.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the configured HTTPS public origin.

SecFetchSite.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
SecFetchSite.description: May be absent or empty; when nonempty, must be same-origin.

X-Request-Id.description: Matches the JSON requestId when a JSON body is returned.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Last applicable per-IP fixed-window limit: API 120/minute, browser 60/minute, start 10/minute, ticket issuance/exchange 20/minute.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining requests in the last applicable limiter. Does not bypass the other applicable limiter.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the exceeded fixed window resets; returned for 429.

WWW-Authenticate.description: For API-path 401: Bearer realm="amzguard-crm", with error="invalid_token" when an Authorization value was supplied.

Set-Cookie.description: One or more Set-Cookie headers. CRM cookies are Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax, without Domain. Binding cookie Max-Age=120; session cookie Max-Age=1800; clearing uses Max-Age=0.

Location.description: Fixed configured HTTPS CRM callback with challengeId, storeKey, view and optional checkId appended.
